proof_scope: Monthly scope only: 2027-01-01 through 2027-01-31, using the period accepted by the real Planner without truncating its returned projection. Actual Chromium, Bun server, operator identity, UI/human authority, protected C08, real SQLite, real Planner, application HTTP, preparation and meeting consumers. The source/history catalog, C06 thread and host source/review-navigation adapters are explicitly controlled. Annual browser performance remains BLOCKED_EXTERNAL after two failed full-year runs. This is not native WP10 installation mounting, C17 physical deletion/replacement, persisted WP08 history or C16 native/MCP execution.
verified_behaviors: All following browser behaviors are verified only for the January 2027 slice; no annual browser performance acceptance is inferred.
Authorized agenda order and removal, stale preview refusal and explicit refresh.
Lost response after real SQLite commit; explicit retry reuses Idempotency-Key and the original review.
A new review preserves 130 while the predecessor remains 120; later Planner value 140 does not silently replace meeting values.
Topic navigation, explicit update check and requestUpdate navigation without automatic new preservation.
Comparison 120 to 130 with delta 10, before/after review navigation and first-review state without fabricated changes.
Attributed preserved comments with author, time and v1 displayed separately from numeric differences.
Exact preserved source digest delegated through a revalidated host callback; rejected destination and revoked review clear headings/list items.
Revoked before-item navigation is refused without opening another review; no browser page errors.
